title: Braket A-Gate Result Row
description: One row per (run, backend, patient, window, channel). Written as Parquet, registered in Athena.

backend.description: Backend short name (sv1, dm1, ionq-aria-1, rigetti-ankaa-3, iqm-garnet, ...).

window_id.description: Stable identifier for the EEG window the parameters were derived from.

channel_index.description: 0-based channel index within the multi-channel A-Gate. -1 indicates a row-level error.

z_e.description: <Z> on the excitatory qubit for this channel, computed from measurement counts.

z_i.description: <Z> on the inhibitory qubit for this channel.

fid_ictal.description: Hellinger fidelity between this window's count distribution and the patient's ictal-state template. In [0, 1].

fid_inter.description: Hellinger fidelity between this window's count distribution and the patient's interictal-state template. In [0, 1].

fid_score.description: fid_ictal - fid_inter. Positive values indicate the window resembles the ictal template more; negative indicate interictal. Sign is the polarity-equivalent observable from Paper 1's pipeline.

wall_time_seconds.description: End-to-end task wall time, including queueing on hardware backends.

error.description: If non-null, the row records a per-window failure rather than a measurement.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag; bump when columns change.
